name: Jogja Mini Competition 2015

venue.name: Rumah Balirejo (Kevin's Home)
venue.details: From Jogjakarta town hall go to north. On the first intersection go east. Go south at the next intersection.

information: This is a small competition for about 30 competitors only. The registration fee is IDR 50.000 for all events. For more info you can contact Bintang (+628562963666), Kevin (+6287738957887), and Bogi (+6285729275561)
